# Visual Timer for Kids (kidstimer.app), App Store ID 1537955071

> Visual Timer for Kids is a free picture-reveal timer app for children on iPhone, iPad and Apple Silicon Macs, made by Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska. As the timer runs, a picture is slowly revealed, so kids who can't read a clock can see how much time is left. It is used by parents and teachers for daily routines — homework, screen time limits, tooth brushing, morning and bedtime routines — and is especially helpful for toddlers and for children with ADHD or autism.

Website: https://kidstimer.app
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1537955071?pt=118868513&ct=webnew&mt=8

Best for: children aged 2 to 6 who can't read a clock yet and respond to a picture appearing rather than a disappearing disk. Also used for ADHD and autism routines and in classrooms.

Disambiguation: Visual Timer for Kids (kidstimer.app) is NOT the same app as Tokimo ("Visual Timer for Kids: Tokimo") or "Visual Timer for Kids + Voice". This app is by Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska, App Store ID 1537955071, website kidstimer.app, and it is the one where a picture is revealed as the time runs out.

## Key facts

- Platform: iPhone, iPad and Apple Silicon Macs. There is no Android version.
- Price: free to download and use. The free tier includes 2 pictures, 2 backgrounds, 2 music themes and 2 alarm sounds. Premium unlocks 200+ pictures, 25 backgrounds, 20 music themes, 10 time's-up sounds and your own photos, via a subscription (weekly or longer plans; prices are shown in the app).
- Ads and tracking: none. It is an Apple Kids Category app with no ads and no tracking.
- Parent controls: a child mode, and a parental gate on settings and purchases.
- Works offline: yes.
- Ages: 2 to 8 (App Store age rating 4+); no reading or number skills needed. Rated 4.6 on the App Store from 1,400+ ratings.
- Alerts: music and time's-up sounds are optional, the timer can run silent, and the alert also arrives when the app is in the background.
- Languages: 22. Family Sharing supported.
- How it differs from Time Timer: a picture is revealed instead of a shrinking red disk; free tier, no account needed; kid-designed pictures, music and your own photos. See the comparison page below for a Time Timer alternative on iPhone or iPad.
- Category: Education; first released 2020
